title: White Summer
notes:
Originally intented to be released in August 2026.

Limited one-batch-only release

Live album recorded at Hong Kong Coliseum on 19th to 20th, 22nd to 24nd, 26th to 27th and 29th to 31st of August, 2025

The album is flat-packed and sleeved in 1 out of 4 random covers, inside a grey blind box

The box set includes:
- Photo album
- 6 lenticular cards
- A miniature of Lam

Album also comes with a poster

All Blu-ray discs are region-free

All Blu-ray discs contain traditional chinese lyrics subtitles and 2 audio tracks:
Audio 1 - DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1 (48kHz/24-bit)
Audio 2 - Uncompressed PCM Stereo (48kHz/24-bit)
